body: # Weekly Market Update: Tech Stocks Lead Market Lower, Basic Materials Gain | Morningstar. *     Stock Market Update for the Trading Week Ended Dec. 12. 3.   Weekly Market Update: Tech Stocks Lead Market Lower, Basic Materials Gain. *   The Morningstar US Market Index fell 0.55%. *   Growth stocks fell 1.12%, blend stocks gained 0.11%, and value stocks rose 1.19%. With investors rotating out of tech stocks, basic materials gained 3.06% and financial services rose 2.38%. This no-moat company with a 4-star rating has decreased 33.1% over the past 12 months. The stock closed the week at $12.15, trading at a 40% discount to its fair value estimate of $14 per share. The 4-star, narrow-moat stock has fallen 32.29% over the last three months and is down 64.13% over the past 12. AmeriCold finished the week at $12.73, trading at a 52% discount to its fair value estimate of $26 per share.
